name: Oregon

statute.readVia: web.archive.org snapshot 2026-09-23 of the official ORS chapter 815 page (2025 edition, notes 2026 session amendments to the chapter)

windshield.strip: darker tint allowed only on the top 6 in. of the windshield; no tint on any other portion

frontSide.note: two tests: film itself at least 50% light transmittance AND total (film + glass) at least 35%; film reflectance max 13%

backSide.note: darker tint allowed on all windows behind the driver of a multipurpose passenger vehicle with rearview mirrors on each side; windows must meet AS-3 glazing requirements

tint.measuredHow: both: film alone (min 50%) and film + glass combined (min 35%)
tint.dualMirrors: Rearview mirrors on each side required for the multipurpose-vehicle rear exemption
tint.certificateOrSticker: Installer must give a certificate (installer name/address, film transmittance and reflectance, statement that total transmittance is at least 35%) that must be kept in the vehicle and shown to police on request

medicalExemption.text: Darker side and rear tint allowed for a vehicle registered to a person (or guardian) when the person or a household member has a physical condition, with an affidavit, prescription or letterhead letter from a licensed physician or optometrist kept in the vehicle and shown to police; windshield not covered

penalty.text: Class B traffic violation (installing or operating): presumptive fine $265, maximum $1,000; court may dismiss or reduce if windows are brought into compliance

quotes: (a) The tinting material has a light transmittance of 50 percent or more; (b) The tinting material has a light reflectance of 13 percent or less; and (c) The total light transmittance through the window with the tinting material applied is 35 percent or more.
may be applied to the top six inches of a windshield. Tinting material may not be applied to any other portion of the windshield.
may be applied to all windows of a multipurpose passenger vehicle that are behind the driver. This subsection applies only to vehicles that are equipped with rearview mirrors on each side

helmet.conditions: All motorcycle operators (814.269) and passengers (814.275); exemptions in 814.290; Class D violation

handheldPhone.fineText: First conviction Class B violation (presumptive $265, max $1,000); Class A if it contributes to a crash or for a second conviction within 10 years; third within 10 years is a crime

studdedTires.season: Nov 1 - Apr 1 (ODOT may extend by rule)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)
